+from __future__ import annotations

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+try:
+    from openai import OpenAI
+except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
+    OpenAI = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ManagedModelPlatformConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None
+    model: Optional[str] = None
+    organization: Optional[str] = None
+    project: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+def load_config(env: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> ManagedModelPlatformConfig:
+    source = os.environ if env is None else env
+    return ManagedModelPlatformConfig(
+        api_key=source.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
+        base_url=source.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL"),
+        model=source.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini"),
+        organization=source.get("OPENAI_ORG_ID"),
+        project=source.get("OPENAI_PROJECT_ID"),
+    )
+
+
+def create_client(config: Optional[ManagedModelPlatformConfig] = None) -> Any:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    if OpenAI is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("openai SDK is not available")
+    kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if cfg.api_key:
+        kwargs["api_key"] = cfg.api_key
+    if cfg.base_url:
+        kwargs["base_url"] = cfg.base_url
+    if cfg.organization:
+        kwargs["organization"] = cfg.organization
+    if cfg.project:
+        kwargs["project"] = cfg.project
+    return OpenAI(**kwargs)
+
+
+def resolve_model(config: Optional[ManagedModelPlatformConfig] = None) -> str:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    if not cfg.model:
+        raise ValueError("model is not configured")
+    return cfg.model
+

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def collect_platform_metadata(prompt: str, model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    model_id = model or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+    response = client.responses.create(model=model_id, input=prompt)
+    return {
+        "output": response.output_text,
+        "metadata": {
+            "provider": "openai",
+            "model": response.model,
+            "response_id": response.id,
+            "usage": response.usage.model_dump() if response.usage else None,
+            "resource_ids": [item.get("id") for item in getattr(response, "output", []) if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("id")],
+            "model_handle": getattr(response, "model", model_id),
+        },
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PlatformResource:
+    provider: str
+    resource_id: str
+    resource_type: str
+    client: Any
+    raw: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def _env(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    return value if value else default
+
+
+def _pick_resource_identifier() -> str:
+    for key in (
+        "OPENAI_MODEL",
+        "OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT",
+        "OPENAI_INFERENCE_PROFILE",
+        "OPENAI_RESOURCE_ID",
+    ):
+        value = _env(key)
+        if value:
+            return value
+    return "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _resource_type(identifier: str) -> str:
+    lowered = identifier.lower()
+    if lowered.startswith("fp_"):
+        return "fine_tuned_model"
+    if "/deployments/" in lowered or lowered.startswith("deployment:"):
+        return "deployment"
+    if lowered.startswith("ip_") or "inference" in lowered:
+        return "inference_profile"
+    return "model"
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(resource_id: Optional[str] = None) -> PlatformResource:
+    identifier = resource_id or _pick_resource_identifier()
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=_env("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    resource_type = _resource_type(identifier)
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = {"provider": "openai", "resource_id": identifier, "resource_type": resource_type}
+    return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource_id=identifier, resource_type=resource_type, client=client, raw=raw)
+
